propositions: Add a nested rebar bridge CLI group exposing only preview (read-only, forces dry-run) and sync (mutating, forces live) verbs as a shippable vertical slice without exposing broken placeholders.
The bridge preview path must perform zero Jira writes and zero ticket or bridge-state writes, proven by exact before/after snapshots and fake transport logs.
The bridge sync path must perform persisted mutations from production-shaped fixtures while preserving unrelated event bytes and state.
Unknown nested verbs must fail with valid choices and never fall through to same-named top-level commands; --mode, --filter-local-ids, and arbitrary trailing arguments must be rejected on both verbs.
Legacy top-level spellings (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor) and internal Mode/MODE_CAPS/gated_mode round trips must remain unchanged and exercised.

Generated CLI reference, exit-code tables, and documentation must describe only the staged bridge surface (preview and sync) and exclude internal vocabulary (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store, numeric exit codes).
